description.en: Talk football like a Kenyan fan: teams, players, goals and results, from Gor Mahia and AFC Leopards to Harambee Stars.
description.so: Kubadda cagta uga hadal sida taageere reer Kenya ah: kooxaha, ciyaartoyda, goolasha iyo natiijooyinka, laga bilaabo Gor Mahia iyo AFC Leopards ilaa Harambee Stars.

body.en: The full name is mpira wa miguu (ball of the feet), but most Kenyans just say mpira or soka. Newspapers and radio also use kandanda. Many football words come from English: goli, refa, penalti, kocha, beki. In the news you will also hear the formal words bao (goal), mwamuzi (referee) and mlinda mlango (goalkeeper).
body.so: Magaca buuxa waa mpira wa miguu (kubadda cagaha), laakiin Kenyaanka badankoodu waxay yiraahdaan mpira ama soka. Wargeysyada iyo raadiyuhu waxay sidoo kale isticmaalaan kandanda. Erayo badan oo kubadda cagta ah waxay ka yimaadeen Ingiriisiga: goli, refa, penalti, kocha, beki. Wararka waxaad sidoo kale ka maqli doontaa erayada rasmiga ah bao (gool), mwamuzi (garsoore) iyo mlinda mlango (goolhaye).

examples.en: The keeper has caught the ball.

body.en: Kenya's biggest club match is Gor Mahia against AFC Leopards. Gor Mahia fans call their club K'Ogalo, and AFC Leopards are called Ingwe (leopard). The match is the Mashemeji derby, from shemeji (in-law). The two clubs' traditional supporters come from neighbouring communities in western Kenya with many marriages between them, so rival fans jokingly call each other in-laws.
body.so: Ciyaarta kooxeed ee ugu weyn Kenya waa Gor Mahia iyo AFC Leopards. Taageerayaasha Gor Mahia kooxdooda waxay ugu yeeraan K'Ogalo, AFC Leopards-na waxaa loo yaqaan Ingwe (shabeel). Ciyaarta waxaa la yiraahdaa Mashemeji derby, oo ka timid shemeji (xidid). Taageerayaasha dhaqameed ee labada kooxood waxay ka yimaadaan bulshooyin deris ah oo ku nool galbeedka Kenya, kuwaas oo aad isu guursada, sidaas darteed taageerayaasha is-diidan waxay kaftan ahaan isugu yeeraan xididdo.

title.en: Harambee Stars and the big stadiums

body.en: Kenya's men's national team is Harambee Stars and the women's team is Harambee Starlets. Harambee means 'let's all pull together' and is Kenya's national motto. Big matches are played in Nairobi at Kasarani (Moi International Sports Centre) and at Nyayo National Stadium.
body.so: Xulka qaranka ragga Kenya waa Harambee Stars, kan haweenkana waa Harambee Starlets. Harambee waxay ka dhigan tahay 'aan wada jiidno', waana halku-dhegga qaranka Kenya. Ciyaaraha waaweyn waxaa lagu ciyaaraa Nairobi, garoonka Kasarani (Moi International Sports Centre) iyo Nyayo National Stadium.

examples.sw: Twende Kasarani tuangalie timu ya taifa!
examples.en: Let's go to Kasarani and watch the national team!
examples.so: Aan aadno Kasarani oo daawanno xulka qaranka!

title.en: The Premier League at the base

body.en: Many Kenyans follow English Premier League clubs as closely as local ones. Friends watch weekend matches together at their base (usual hangout), at a hoteli with a TV, or in a video hall where you pay a few shillings to watch. Scores use bila (without) for nil: mbili bila is 2–0, moja moja is 1–1, mbili kwa moja is 2–1.
body.so: Kenyaan badan waxay kooxaha Premier League-ka Ingiriiska ula socdaan sida kuwa gudaha oo kale. Saaxiibbadu ciyaaraha dhammaadka toddobaadka waxay ku wada daawadaan base-kooda (meesha ay caadi ahaan ku kulmaan), hoteli TV leh, ama video hall oo aad shilin yar ku bixiso si aad u daawato. Natiijooyinka, eber waxaa loo yiraahdaa bila (la'aan): mbili bila waa 2–0, moja moja waa 1–1, mbili kwa moja waa 2–1.

examples.so: Laba iyo eber ayaan ku garaacnay.

body.en: Fans talk about results with -me- (has/have) and -li- (did). Tumeshinda! = We've won! Tulishinda jana = We won yesterday. Tumewachapa! (We've thrashed them!) is what you shout after a big win. You will learn these tenses fully in the unit Telling what happened.
body.so: Taageerayaashu natiijooyinka waxay kaga hadlaan -me- (hadda dhacay) iyo -li- (wakhti tegay). Tumeshinda! = Waan guulaysannay! Tulishinda jana = Shalay ayaan guulaysannay. Tumewachapa! (Waan garaacnay!) waa waxa aad ku qayliso guul weyn kadib. Wakhtiyadan si buuxda ayaad ugu baran doontaa cutubka Telling what happened.

examples.en: We've won! We've thrashed them three-nil!
examples.so: Waan guulaysannay! Saddex iyo eber ayaan ku garaacnay!

note.en: Kenyans also use mpira for the game itself: Unaenda mpira? (Are you going to the match?)
note.so: Kenyaanku mpira waxay sidoo kale ugu yeeraan ciyaarta lafteeda: Unaenda mpira? (Ciyaarta ma u socotaa?)

note.en: Literally 'ball of the feet'.
note.so: Macnaha ereyga: 'kubadda cagaha'.

note.en: News and radio also say kandanda.
note.so: Wararka iyo raadiyuhu waxay sidoo kale yiraahdaan kandanda.

note.en: Uwanja is any open ground: uwanja wa ndege is an airport, uwanja wa michezo a sports ground.
note.so: Uwanja waa dhul kasta oo bannaan: uwanja wa ndege waa garoonka diyaaradaha, uwanja wa michezo waa garoonka ciyaaraha.

note.en: Plural: wachezaji (players).
note.so: Wadarta: wachezaji (ciyaartoy).

note.en: Formal: mlinda mlango (guard of the door).
note.so: Qaabka rasmiga ah: mlinda mlango (ilaaliyaha albaabka).

note.en: From English 'back'. Formal: mlinzi.
note.so: Waxay ka timid Ingiriisiga 'back'. Qaabka rasmiga ah: mlinzi.

note.en: Fans also say straika.
note.so: Taageerayaashu waxay sidoo kale yiraahdaan straika.

note.en: Goli is both the goalposts and a goal scored.
note.so: Goli waa labadaba: tiirarka goolka iyo goolka la dhaliyo.

note.en: The word news reports use for goals scored: mabao mawili = two goals.
note.so: Ereyga wararku u isticmaalaan goolasha la dhaliyo: mabao mawili = laba gool.

note.en: Kufunga means 'to close' or 'to tie', and in sport 'to score'. Amefunga! = He has scored!
note.so: Kufunga waxay ka dhigan tahay 'xirid', ciyaarahana 'dhalin'. Amefunga! = Wuu dhaliyay!

note.en: Literally 'to be won over'. Tulishindwa = we lost.
note.so: Macnaha ereyga: 'in lagaa guulaysto'. Tulishindwa = waa nalaga badiyay.

note.en: Kenyans also say droo. Walitoka sare = they drew.
note.so: Kenyaanku waxay sidoo kale yiraahdaan droo. Walitoka sare = barbaro ayay ku kala tageen.

note.en: One fan is shabiki. Kushabikia = to support a team.
note.so: Hal taageere waa shabiki. Kushabikia = koox taageerid.

items.en: Which team do you support? (lit. Your team is which?)

note.en: Iko aje? is the Kenyan way to ask 'how is it?'.
note.so: Iko aje? waa sida Kenya loo weydiiyo 'sidee tahay?'.

note.en: Kuchapa means 'to beat' (hit). Fans love it after a win.
note.so: Kuchapa waxay ka dhigan tahay 'garaacid'. Taageerayaashu aad bay u jecel yihiin guul kadib.

note.en: Bila means 'without'. Moja moja = 1–1, mbili kwa moja = 2–1.
note.so: Bila waxay ka dhigan tahay 'la'aan'. Moja moja = 1–1, mbili kwa moja = 2–1.

note.en: Formal: mwamuzi (judge).
note.so: Qaabka rasmiga ah: mwamuzi (garsoore).

note.en: In commentary: mkwaju wa penalti (penalty kick).
note.so: Faallada ciyaaraha: mkwaju wa penalti (laadka rigoorada).

items.en: The referee has blown the whistle

note.en: Filimbi = whistle. Kupiga filimbi = to blow the whistle.
note.so: Filimbi = foodhi. Kupiga filimbi = foodhi afuufid.

note.en: Harambee = 'let's all pull together', Kenya's national motto.
note.so: Harambee = 'aan wada jiidno', halku-dhegga qaranka Kenya.

items.en: Mashemeji derby (Gor Mahia v AFC Leopards)
items.so: Ciyaarta Mashemeji (Gor Mahia iyo AFC Leopards)

note.en: Shemeji means in-law. Rival fans jokingly call each other in-laws.
note.so: Shemeji waa xidid. Taageerayaasha is-diidan waxay kaftan ahaan isugu yeeraan xididdo.

note.en: Friends' usual meeting place, often where they watch matches.
note.so: Meesha saaxiibbadu caadi ahaan ku kulmaan, inta badan halkaas ayay ciyaaraha ku daawadaan.

note.en: From English 'watch'. Standard: kutazama or kuangalia.
note.so: Waxay ka timid Ingiriisiga 'watch'. Qaabka caadiga ah: kutazama ama kuangalia.

note.en: The standard verb is kushabikia: Unashabikia timu gani?
note.so: Falka caadiga ahi waa kushabikia: Unashabikia timu gani?

note.en: English 'fans' with the Swahili plural ma-.
note.so: Ingiriisiga 'fans' oo lagu daray horgalaha wadarta Swahiliga ma-.

note.en: From kuchapa (to beat). Walipata kichapo = they got thrashed.
note.so: Waxay ka timid kuchapa (garaacid). Walipata kichapo = si xun ayaa looga adkaaday.
